metrics.final_message:
The `todos` package is in place. `hd check --tests` and `hd test` both pass: 14 tests (13 unit tests in `src/todos.hd`, 1 integration test in `tests/todos.hd`), and `hd lint` is clean.

Files:

- **`src/todos.hd`** holds the public API from your spec: `Todo` and `TodoError` (both `@derive(Eq, Debug)`), plus `load`, `dump`, `complete` and `pending`.
  - `load` decodes the JSON with `Serialize`/`Deserialize` derives. A missing `done` defaults to `false` through the field default. Any decode failure becomes `BadJson` with the decoder's message.
  - `complete` returns `UnknownId` when no todo has that id.
  - `pending` returns the titles that are not done, in order.
- **`src/lib.hd`** re-exports the public items, so callers write `todos.Todo`, `todos.load`, and so on. I added this because hd requires a library's root to be `src/lib.hd`, not `src/todos.hd`.
- **`tests/todos.hd`** replaces the generated sample test, which referenced a `greet` function that no longer exists.
- **`hd.toml`** is the package manifest, generated by `hd new --lib`.

No git repository exists here, so I made no commit and no attribution lines were needed.
